darkpll.summary: Clock/reset generator: stretches the external reset with a down-counter, feeds a vendor PLL/MMCM (or passes XCLK through) and releases the internal reset via a second counter after LOCKED.

blocks.name: input_reset_stretch
blocks.description: Stretches external reset XRES for PLL reset using IRES counter.

anchors.name: IRES
anchors.why: Reset-stretch down-counter on XCLK; IRES[7] resets the PLL and defines LOCKED in bypass.

anchors.name: XRES
anchors.why: External reset request reloading the IRES stretch counter.

blocks.name: clock_generator
blocks.description: Vendor PLL/MMCM or bypass producing CLK and LOCKED from XCLK.

anchors.name: LOCKED
anchors.why: PLL lock flag; while low it reloads DRES holding internal reset.

blocks.name: output_reset_sync
blocks.description: Holds RES asserted until DRES counts down after PLL lock.

anchors.name: DRES
anchors.why: Down-counter on CLK delaying reset release after lock; MSB drives RES.

anchors.name: RES
anchors.why: Generated internal reset output synchronized to CLK from DRES[7].

darkriscv.summary: DarkRISCV 3-stage RV32I core: fetch PC, registered decode (instruction, opcode flags, immediates), single-cycle execute with register file, ALU, branch unit and load/store bus, plus halt/flush control and M/S trap CSRs.

blocks.name: Instruction fetch
blocks.description: Fetch PC, instruction bus request and halt-safe instruction capture.

anchors.name: IFPC
anchors.why: Fetch-stage PC driving IADDR; loads reset, trap, jump target or PC+4.

anchors.name: IDATA
anchors.why: Fetched instruction word from instruction bus.

anchors.name: IDREQ
anchors.why: Instruction fetch request, active out of reset.

anchors.name: IDACK
anchors.why: Instruction fetch acknowledge releasing HLT.

anchors.name: HLT2
anchors.why: Delayed halt selecting held instruction IDATA2.

anchors.name: IDATA2
anchors.why: Instruction captured on halt transitions, replayed after stall.

anchors.name: IDATAX
anchors.why: Halt-aware instruction feeding decode registers.

anchors.name: IDPC
anchors.why: Decode-stage PC, link value for JAL/JALR.

blocks.name: Decode
blocks.description: Registered instruction, opcode flags and immediates; FLUSH-gated decode.

anchors.name: XIDATA
anchors.why: Decode/execute instruction register; fields feed register pointers, FCT3 and CSR decode.

anchors.name: FCT3
anchors.why: funct3 field selecting ALU op, branch condition and access size.

anchors.name: LCC
anchors.why: Load decode: drives DRD/DDREQ and selects LDATA writeback.

anchors.name: SCC
anchors.why: Store decode: drives DWR/DDREQ and read/write direction.

anchors.name: XSIMM
anchors.why: Registered sign-extended immediate per instruction format.

anchors.name: XMCC
anchors.why: Registered immediate-ALU decode selecting SIMM as second operand.

anchors.name: CSRX
anchors.why: CSR instruction decode enabling CSR writes and CRDATA writeback.

anchors.name: EBRK
anchors.why: EBREAK decode causing trap to STVEC and flush.

anchors.name: MRET
anchors.why: MRET decode returning PC to MEPC.

anchors.name: SRET
anchors.why: SRET decode returning PC to SEPC.

blocks.name: Register file
blocks.description: Register array with two read ports and writeback mux.

anchors.name: REGS
anchors.why: 32x32 register file written via DPTR, read via S1PTR/S2PTR.

anchors.name: DPTR
anchors.why: Destination register index for REGS writeback.

anchors.name: S1PTR
anchors.why: Source-1 register index reading U1REG.

anchors.name: S2PTR
anchors.why: Source-2 register index reading U2REG.

anchors.name: U1REG
anchors.why: Source-1 operand feeding ALU, address adder and CSR mask.

blocks.name: Execute
blocks.description: ALU, branch comparator and jump target generation.

anchors.name: RMDATA
anchors.why: ALU result for register/immediate ops selected by FCT3, written to REGS.

anchors.name: BMUX
anchors.why: Branch condition comparator result by FCT3.

anchors.name: PCSIMM
anchors.why: PC+immediate for branch/JAL target and AUIPC.

anchors.name: JREQ
anchors.why: Jump/taken-branch request redirecting IFPC and triggering flush.

anchors.name: JVAL
anchors.why: Jump target: DADDR for JALR else PC+SIMM.

anchors.name: PC
anchors.why: Execute-stage PC used for branch target and trap EPC.

blocks.name: Load/store unit
blocks.description: Data bus address, byte lanes, strobes and load alignment.

anchors.name: DADDR
anchors.why: Data bus address U1REG+SIMM, also JALR target.

anchors.name: DATAO
anchors.why: Store data positioned by byte lane from SDATA.

anchors.name: DATAI
anchors.why: Load data from data bus, aligned/extended into LDATA.

anchors.name: DDREQ
anchors.why: Data bus request for load or store; stalls core until DDACK.

anchors.name: DDACK
anchors.why: Data bus acknowledge releasing HLT.

anchors.name: LDATA
anchors.why: Byte/half aligned, sign-extended load data for writeback.

anchors.name: DWR
anchors.why: Data bus write strobe for stores.

anchors.name: DRD
anchors.why: Data bus read strobe for loads.

anchors.name: DBE
anchors.why: Byte enables from access size and address low bits.

blocks.name: Pipeline control
blocks.description: Halt on bus wait, flush after redirects, exception detection.

anchors.name: FLUSH
anchors.why: Pipeline flush countdown after reset, jumps, traps; squashes decoded opcodes.

anchors.name: HLT
anchors.why: Stall while instruction or data bus request lacks ack; freezes all stages.

anchors.name: XRES
anchors.why: Registered core reset forcing reset PC, flush and CSR clear.

anchors.name: IERR
anchors.why: Illegal instruction flag causing trap and flush.

anchors.name: DAER
anchors.why: Data address misalignment flag causing trap.

anchors.name: IAER
anchors.why: Instruction address misalignment flag causing trap.

blocks.name: CSR and traps
blocks.description: Machine interrupt and supervisor exception CSRs with read/write mux.

anchors.name: MIP
anchors.why: Machine interrupt pending; with JREQ redirects PC to MTVEC.

anchors.name: MSTATUS
anchors.why: Machine status; MIE bit gates interrupt pending.

anchors.name: MIE
anchors.why: Machine interrupt enable mask gating MIP.

anchors.name: MTVEC
anchors.why: Interrupt vector loaded into IFPC on pending interrupt.

anchors.name: MEPC
anchors.why: Saved return PC on interrupt, restored by MRET.

anchors.name: MCAUSE
anchors.why: Interrupt cause readable via CSR.

anchors.name: STVEC
anchors.why: Exception vector; nonzero enables trap redirect of IFPC.

anchors.name: SEPC
anchors.why: Saved PC on exception, restored by SRET.

anchors.name: SCAUSE
anchors.why: Exception cause code from error flags.

anchors.name: CRDATA
anchors.why: CSR read mux by CSR address, written back to REGS.

anchors.name: WRDATA
anchors.why: CSR write value for CSRRW/RS/RC.

anchors.name: CSRCLK
anchors.why: 64-bit cycle counter CSR.

anchors.name: CSRINS
anchors.why: 64-bit retired-instruction counter CSR.

blocks.name: Debug
blocks.description: Oscilloscope debug outputs.

anchors.name: DEBUG
anchors.why: Debug view of IRQ, MIP, MIE and MRET.

darkbridge.summary: DarkRISCV bus bridge: wraps the darkriscv core, passing its instruction bus to a Harvard Y-bus and its data bus to the X-bus (optional caches bypassed), and derives halt from pending unacknowledged requests.

blocks.name: core
blocks.description: darkriscv core with its instruction and data bus ports.

anchors.name: IDREQ
anchors.why: Core instruction request, forwarded to Y-bus.

anchors.name: IDACK
anchors.why: Instruction ack to core from Y-bus.

anchors.name: DDREQ
anchors.why: Core data request, forwarded to X-bus.

anchors.name: DDACK
anchors.why: Data ack to core from X-bus.

anchors.name: DADDR
anchors.why: Core data address routed to X-bus address.

anchors.name: XIRQ
anchors.why: External interrupt request into core.

blocks.name: instruction_bus
blocks.description: Pass-through from core instruction bus to Harvard Y-bus (no I-cache).

anchors.name: YADDR
anchors.why: Instruction bus address from core fetch PC.

anchors.name: YDATA
anchors.why: Fetched instruction data returned to core.

anchors.name: YDREQ
anchors.why: Instruction bus request from core.

anchors.name: YDACK
anchors.why: Instruction bus acknowledge to core.

blocks.name: data_bus
blocks.description: Pass-through from core data bus to X-bus (no D-cache).

anchors.name: XXADDR
anchors.why: External data bus address from core data address.

anchors.name: XXATAO
anchors.why: External data bus write data from core.

anchors.name: XXATAI
anchors.why: External data bus read data returned to core.

anchors.name: XXDREQ
anchors.why: External data bus request.

anchors.name: XXDACK
anchors.why: External data bus acknowledge, completes core data access.

anchors.name: XXWR
anchors.why: External data bus write strobe.

anchors.name: XXRD
anchors.why: External data bus read strobe.

anchors.name: XXBE
anchors.why: External data bus byte enables.

blocks.name: halt_logic
blocks.description: Halt when any bus request is pending without acknowledge.

anchors.name: IHLT
anchors.why: Halt when instruction or data request pending without ack.

anchors.name: HLT
anchors.why: Halt output driven by pending-bus condition.

anchors.name: DEBUG
anchors.why: Debug probe of request/ack/halt signals.

darkram.summary: DarkRISCV unified dual-port block RAM: one 32-bit memory array serves a registered instruction read port and a data port with byte-enable writes and a wait-state ack counter.

blocks.name: Unified memory
blocks.description: Shared BRAM array initialized from darksocv.mem.

anchors.name: MEM
anchors.why: 2048x32 memory array shared by instruction fetch and data load/store.

blocks.name: Instruction port
blocks.description: Registered instruction read with request passthrough ack.

anchors.name: IADDR
anchors.why: Instruction fetch word address indexing MEM.

anchors.name: IDATA
anchors.why: Fetched instruction from registered read ROMFF.

anchors.name: IDREQ
anchors.why: Instruction fetch request, passed straight to IDACK.

anchors.name: IDACK
anchors.why: Instruction fetch acknowledge, equal to IDREQ without wait states.

blocks.name: Data port
blocks.description: Registered data read and byte-enable write path.

anchors.name: XDREQ
anchors.why: Data-bus request starting reads and qualifying byte writes.

anchors.name: XDACK
anchors.why: Data-bus acknowledge: read wait-state done or immediate write.

anchors.name: XADDR
anchors.why: Data-bus word address for MEM read and byte writes.

anchors.name: XATAI
anchors.why: Store data written into MEM byte lanes.

anchors.name: XATAO
anchors.why: Load data from registered read RAMFF.

anchors.name: XRD
anchors.why: Read command starting the read wait-state counter.

anchors.name: XWR
anchors.why: Write command enabling byte-lane writes and immediate ack.

anchors.name: XBE
anchors.why: Per-byte write enables for MEM data writes.

blocks.name: Data wait-state timer
blocks.description: Counts read wait states to generate XDACK.

anchors.name: DTACK
anchors.why: Data read wait-state down-counter; ack when it reaches 1.

blocks.name: Debug
blocks.description: Data-bus activity debug output.

anchors.name: DEBUG
anchors.why: Debug view of data-bus request, read, write and ack.

darkuart.summary: DarkRISCV bus-mapped UART: independent TX and RX state machines with baud down-counters move bytes between single-byte buffers and serial lines, using toggle req/ack flags and a state-change IRQ.

blocks.name: Bus interface
blocks.description: Register read/write decode, status snapshot and IRQ generation.

anchors.name: DATAO
anchors.why: Bus read data: baud timer, received byte and UART status.

anchors.name: DATAI
anchors.why: Bus write data; byte 1 loaded into TX buffer.

anchors.name: WR
anchors.why: Bus write loading TX buffer and LASTCHAR.

anchors.name: RD
anchors.why: Bus read acknowledging RX byte and status.

anchors.name: BE
anchors.why: Byte enables selecting TX data byte or status ack.

anchors.name: UART_STATE
anchors.why: Status byte: RX data available and TX busy flags.

anchors.name: UART_STATEFF
anchors.why: Snapshot of status on read; differences raise IRQ.

anchors.name: IRQ
anchors.why: Interrupt when status differs from last acknowledged snapshot.

blocks.name: TX engine
blocks.description: TX FSM serializes buffered byte with start and stop bits.

anchors.name: UART_XSTATE
anchors.why: TX sequencer idle/start/data bits/stop/ack; low bits index transmitted bit.

anchors.name: TXD
anchors.why: Serial transmit line driven by TX state and buffered byte bit.

anchors.name: UART_XFIFO
anchors.why: TX byte buffer held while the TX FSM shifts its bits out.

anchors.name: UART_XREQ
anchors.why: Toggle request from bus write; XREQ!=XACK starts transmission.

anchors.name: UART_XACK
anchors.why: TX ack toggled at end of frame to complete transmit request.

blocks.name: RX engine
blocks.description: RX FSM detects start edge and deserializes bits into buffer.

anchors.name: UART_RSTATE
anchors.why: RX sequencer with start detection; indexes received bit position.

anchors.name: RXD
anchors.why: Serial receive line shifted into the RXD synchronizer.

anchors.name: UART_RFIFO
anchors.why: RX byte register assembled bit by bit, held until read through DATAO.

anchors.name: UART_RREQ
anchors.why: Toggle flag marking received byte available to the bus.

anchors.name: UART_RACK
anchors.why: RX ack updated on bus read of byte 1, consuming received byte.

anchors.name: UART_RXDFF
anchors.why: 3-stage RXD synchronizer used for start-edge detect and sampling.

blocks.name: Baud timers
blocks.description: TX/RX baud down-counters reloaded from constant timer.

anchors.name: UART_XBAUD
anchors.why: TX baud down-counter advancing UART_XSTATE at zero.

anchors.name: UART_RBAUD
anchors.why: RX baud down-counter, half-period preload for mid-bit sampling.

anchors.name: UART_TIMER
anchors.why: Constant baud divisor reloading both baud counters.

blocks.name: Debug
blocks.description: Oscilloscope debug outputs.

anchors.name: DEBUG
anchors.why: Debug view of RXD, TXD and TX/RX busy.

darkio.summary: DarkRISCV memory-mapped I/O block: address-decoded bus writes set LED/OPORT/timer registers and IRQ acks, reads are muxed into a registered read-data register with a wait-state ack, and a programmable timer raises toggle-based IRQs alongside a UART instance.

blocks.name: bus_interface
blocks.description: Address decode, read mux register and wait-state acknowledge.

anchors.name: XADDR
anchors.why: Bus address decoded to select IO registers and UART.

anchors.name: XATAI
anchors.why: Bus write data loaded into LED, OPORT, timer and IRQ-ack registers.

anchors.name: XATAO
anchors.why: Bus read data driven from read mux register.

anchors.name: XDREQ
anchors.why: Bus request qualifying reads and writes.

anchors.name: XDACK
anchors.why: Bus ack: immediate on write, after wait-state on read.

anchors.name: XWR
anchors.why: Write command enabling register updates and UART write.

anchors.name: XRD
anchors.why: Read command loading read mux register and starting wait-state.

anchors.name: IOMUXFF
anchors.why: Registered read-data mux of board ID, UART, LED, timer, ports.

anchors.name: DTACK
anchors.why: Read wait-state counter generating delayed ack.

blocks.name: timer
blocks.description: Programmable periodic timer and microsecond counter.

anchors.name: TIMERFF
anchors.why: Software-programmable timer reload value; enables timer.

anchors.name: TIMER
anchors.why: Timer down-counter reloaded from TIMERFF; zero raises IRQ.

anchors.name: TIMEUSFF
anchors.why: Microsecond prescale down-counter.

anchors.name: TIMEUS
anchors.why: Microsecond uptime counter readable over bus.

blocks.name: irq_controller
blocks.description: Toggle req/ack interrupt bits producing XIRQ.

anchors.name: IREQ
anchors.why: Toggle IRQ request bits set by timer expiry.

anchors.name: IACK
anchors.why: Toggle IRQ ack bits written by software to clear IRQs.

anchors.name: BOARD_IRQ
anchors.why: Pending IRQ vector IREQ xor IACK, readable and ORed to XIRQ.

anchors.name: XIRQ
anchors.why: Interrupt request to CPU when any IRQ pending.

blocks.name: gpio_registers
blocks.description: LED and general-purpose output registers plus input port.

anchors.name: LEDFF
anchors.why: Software-written LED register driving LED output.

anchors.name: OPORTFF
anchors.why: Software-written general-purpose output port register.

anchors.name: IPORT
anchors.why: General-purpose input port readable via mux.

anchors.name: LED
anchors.why: LED output from LEDFF.

anchors.name: OPORT
anchors.why: General-purpose output from OPORTFF.

blocks.name: uart
blocks.description: darkuart instance mapped at address window 1.

anchors.name: UDATA
anchors.why: UART read data into read mux.

anchors.name: RXD
anchors.why: UART receive line into uart0.

anchors.name: TXD
anchors.why: UART transmit line from uart0.

darksocv.summary: DarkRISCV SoC top: a darkbridge-wrapped core drives an X-bus whose address bits [31:30] decode chip selects for BRAM, I/O, SDRAM/stub and unmapped regions, muxing back read data and acks.

blocks.name: CPU bridge
blocks.description: darkbridge core issuing X-bus data requests and Y-bus instruction fetches.

anchors.name: XDREQ
anchors.why: Core data-bus request from bridge0, gated per region into XDREQMUX.

anchors.name: XADDR
anchors.why: Core data-bus address; bits [31:30] select the target slave.

anchors.name: XATAO
anchors.why: Core write data broadcast to BRAM, I/O and SDRAM slaves.

anchors.name: XWR
anchors.why: Write strobe from core to BRAM and I/O slaves.

anchors.name: XRD
anchors.why: Read strobe from core to BRAM and I/O slaves.

anchors.name: XBE
anchors.why: Byte enables for slave writes.

anchors.name: HLT
anchors.why: Core halt from bridge stalling on pending requests; fed to BRAM and I/O.

anchors.name: XIRQ
anchors.why: Timer interrupt from io0 to the core bridge.

blocks.name: Address decoder and return mux
blocks.description: XADDR[31:30] selects slave request and muxes read data/ack.

anchors.name: XDREQMUX
anchors.why: Address-decoded per-slave request selects: BRAM, I/O, SDRAM, unmapped.

anchors.name: XATAIMUX
anchors.why: Per-slave read data array, indexed by XADDR[31:30] back to core.

anchors.name: XDACKMUX
anchors.why: Per-slave ack array selected by XADDR[31:30] for the core.

blocks.name: Block RAM
blocks.description: Dual-port BRAM for instructions and data at region 0.

anchors.name: IADDR
anchors.why: Harvard instruction address from bridge to BRAM instruction port.

anchors.name: IDATA
anchors.why: Instruction word returned from BRAM to the core.

blocks.name: I/O block
blocks.description: darkio UART, GPIO, LED and timer IRQ at region 1.

anchors.name: UART_RXD
anchors.why: UART receive line into io0.

anchors.name: UART_TXD
anchors.why: UART transmit line from io0.

anchors.name: LED
anchors.why: LED register output from io0.

anchors.name: oport
anchors.why: GPIO output from io0 driving OPORT.

anchors.name: iport
anchors.why: GPIO input from IPORT into io0.

blocks.name: Unmapped region responders
blocks.description: Countdown acks returning deadbeef for regions 2 and 3.

anchors.name: DTACK2
anchors.why: Wait-state counter acking unmapped SDRAM region accesses.

anchors.name: DTACK3
anchors.why: Wait-state counter acking unmapped region 3 accesses.

blocks.name: Clock/reset
blocks.description: Reset stretcher/PLL producing CLK and RES.

anchors.name: RES
anchors.why: Internal stretched reset generated from XRES distributed to all blocks.
